turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've been trying to activate my new card in the app for an hour and it keeps failing. I'm getting really annoyed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. The activation failed because the card hadn't been marked as delivered on our side. I've updated that, so please try again now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I just tried again and the app says the card is active.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, the activation went through on our side as well, and the card is ready for payments.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Brilliant, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, I'm really happy it's sorted!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, enjoy using your new card.

note: All labels hold: explicit customer escalation, still unresolved, negative throughout.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My transfer to my landlord was declined again today and nobody can tell me why. This is unacceptable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. The payment was stopped by an automated security check, and the review team has to clear it before it can go through.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's what I was told yesterday. I want to speak to a supervisor right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've raised an escalation to a supervisor. They will contact you within two working days; I can't release the transfer myself.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two more days? My rent is already late and I'm furious that this still isn't fixed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. The case is marked urgent and the supervisor will review it.

note: All labels hold: open informational question, neutral throughout.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. I'm moving to Portugal next month. Can I keep using my account as a resident there?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for asking. Our list of supported countries is being updated, so I need to check Portugal with our compliance team first.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. When will I get an answer?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Compliance usually replies within five working days, and we will send the answer to the email address on your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. I'll wait for the email then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted. The request stays open and you'll hear from us once compliance has confirmed.

note: Target names a transfer intent, but the dialogue is an in-app currency exchange.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to convert 200 pounds from my balance into euros in the app, but I can't find where to do it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can do that in the app: open your GBP balance, tap Exchange, choose EUR and enter the amount.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Found it. I've converted the 200 pounds and the euros are showing in my EUR balance now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Right, the exchange is complete and the euros are available to spend.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome.

note: Target says resolved, but only a future investigation and refund are promised.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't recognise a card payment of 89 euros from a shop called Brightmart. I'm worried about it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I've opened a dispute for that payment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Will I get my money back?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The disputes team will investigate and decide within ten working days. If the payment is confirmed as unauthorised, we'll refund you then.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. I'm still anxious about it, but I'll wait to hear from them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We'll email you as soon as there's an update.

note: Target says unresolved, but the PIN change is completed and confirmed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, how do I change the PIN on my card?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: In the app, open Card, tap Change PIN, and enter the new four digits twice.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Done, the app says my new PIN has been set.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I can see the PIN change went through. It's active immediately.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome.

note: Target says escalation requested, but only the agent offers it and the customer declines.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why was I charged a 2 euro fee on my card payment yesterday? This is really annoying.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. That fee applies to card payments in a foreign currency beyond your monthly allowance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I didn't know about that allowance. Can you refund it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can't refund it myself, but I can pass this to a supervisor if you'd like.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, don't bother. I'm still annoyed about the fee, but I'll check the allowance myself.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. The allowance is shown under Plan in the app.

note: Target says no escalation, but the customer explicitly asks for a manager.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My cash withdrawal was declined at the ATM twice today, and I really need the money. This is so frustrating.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. I can see both attempts were declined, but the system doesn't show a reason yet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's not good enough. I want to speak to your manager.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've asked my manager to call you back today. Meanwhile our technical team is still checking the declines.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, but I'm still really unhappy that I can't get my money.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, and I'm sorry for the trouble.

note: Target says negative start, but the first customer turn is a factual question.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I've just ordered a physical card. How long does delivery usually take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Standard delivery takes three to five working days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I pay for faster delivery?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, express delivery takes one to two working days, and you can choose it when ordering.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, that's really helpful. I'm happy with that, thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. You'll get a notification when it's dispatched.

turns.text: My automatic top-up didn't trigger yesterday even though my balance went below the threshold. That's annoying.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. Your top-up card had expired, so the automatic top-up couldn't run.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see. I've just added my new card [[CREDIT_CARD_1]] in the app.
